name: F0X
notes: Manifest owned by the game repository: pinned G-Diffuser sources and the Apple patch series, built with no ROM; players choose their F-Zero X ROM in the app.

inputs.description: Your own F-Zero X (USA, revision 0) ROM as a big-endian .z64 file. You choose it in F0X after installing; the build does not read it.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

publication.reason: Each copy is built on the player's own Mac from F-Zero X decompilation sources, so it stays personal. The ROM is chosen in the app after installing.

steps: Open {file} and move F0X.app to your Applications folder.
Open F0X and choose Manage Game Data to pick your own F-Zero X (USA, revision 0) ROM; F0X builds its game data on this Mac.
Updating? Replace the old F0X.app with the new one. Your saves and game data are kept.
